title: ExecutionReservation + reserve_once contract (Action Clearance prerequisites)
description: Design artifact, NOT a committed runtime contract. Product execution envelope + atomic reserve-once contract. Defines semantics only; selects no database. Neutral contracts are unchanged.

x-reserve-once.signature: reserve_once(execution_key, clearance_receipt_ref, expected_authorization_ref, expected_action_fingerprint, reservation_ttl) -> ReservationResult
x-reserve-once.atomic_property: At most one caller may acquire an executable reservation for the same execution key; exactly one returns ACQUIRED under concurrency.

inside_atomic_transaction: uniqueness insert on execution_key (no prior reservation/completion)
durable state read deciding ACQUIRED vs ALREADY_*

x-uncertain-outcome-rule: A timed-out caller does not imply the action did not occur. OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN requires reconciliation before reuse; never auto-released. RECONCILED_SUCCESS permanently prevents duplicate execution; RECONCILED_FAILURE may permit controlled retry per policy.
x-backend-decision: OPEN_IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION (enforcement blocker): SQL uniqueness+transaction | CAS document store | append-only event store w/ unique key | distributed lock + durable record | in-memory (tests only). No backend implemented in this phase.
